metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.liveness_rule: Liveness means component runtime is alive according to declared probe/profile.
semantics.readiness_rule: Readiness means component can accept its declared work profile.
semantics.separation_rule: Live but not ready is valid.
semantics.traffic_rule: Routing/admission may consume readiness but must not treat it as authorization.
semantics.startup_rule: Startup may pass liveness before readiness.
semantics.shutdown_rule: Component may become unready before stopping.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown readiness follows explicit fail-closed routing/admission policy.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: startup traffic starts before readiness without policy
